sections.label: ASEAN defence chairmanship aims
sections.summary: As 2018 ADMM and ADMM-Plus Chairman, Singapore aims to enhance counter-terrorism cooperation, improve response to chemical, biological and radiological threats, and develop confidence-building measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: As the Chairman of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and ADMM-Plus in 2018, we aim to: (a) enhance regional counter-terrorism cooperation; (b) improve the region’s capability to respond to chemical, biological and radiological threats from terrorist groups and rogue actors; and (c) develop practical confidence-building measures and codes for unplanned encounters in the aviation and maritime domains, to reduce the risk of miscalculation and de-escalate tensions in the region.

sections.label: MINDEF bilateral defence relations
sections.summary: MINDEF has deepened defence relations through a new US Navy naval exercise, a Naval Bilateral Agreement with India, Queensland training facilities, and ties with China.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Bilaterally, MINDEF has deepened relations with defence partners through initiatives, such as a new naval exercise with the US Navy and a new Naval Bilateral Agreement with India.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: Cooperation with Australia is progressing steadily as we commence construction of facilities to support more SAF troops to train in Queensland in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: We will strengthen our ties with China and deepen military-to-military ties between SAF and the People’s Liberation Army.

sections.label: Hybrid warfare and social compact
sections.summary: In this new era, hybrid warfare can be waged first through cyberspace, and aggressors will seek to turn Singaporeans against one another to weaken the social compact.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
sentences.text: In this new era, where hybrid warfare can be waged first through cyberspace before any physical means, potential aggressors will seek to turn one Singaporean against another to weaken our social compact.
